no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: All wholly-owned candidates are pre-IND/preclinical as of 2025 10-K (filed Mar 2026). SZN-8141 (Fzd4 agonist + VEGF antagonist) IND submission anticipated 2H 2026 for diabetic macular edema and wet AMD. SZN-8143 (Fzd4/VEGF/IL-6 trispecific) is preclinical for DME, wet AMD and uveitic macular edema. SZN-413 is out-licensed to Boehringer Ingelheim (IND-enabling tox study completed Mar 2026; partner-owned development). SZN-043 in severe alcohol-associated hepatitis was discontinued in Q1 2025.

excluded_preclinical.modality: Fzd4 agonism + VEGF antagonism + IL-6 antagonism

excluded_legacy_terminated.reason: Development discontinued Q1 2025 due to insufficient early efficacy signal
